mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM policy_versions middle JOIN policy_versions basis ON basis.id = #{basisId} JOIN policy_versions displayed ON displayed.id = #{versionId} WHERE middle.policy_type = basis.policy_type AND middle.published_at IS NOT NULL AND (middle.effective_at > basis.effective_at OR (middle.effective_at = basis.effective_at AND middle.id > basis.id)) AND (middle.effective_at < displayed.effective_at OR (middle.effective_at = displayed.effective_at AND middle.id < displayed.id)) AND (middle.requires_reconsent = 1 OR middle.consent_basis_version_id IS NULL OR middle.consent_basis_version_id = middle.id OR middle.consent_basis_version_id != basis.id) )
